note: The project author, playing the prospect, asked what kind of news counts and then said there was none. Committed exactly as ElevenLabs stored it.

turns.text: Hi, I'm an AI assistant calling on behalf of Meridian Communications. I'll keep this under a minute. Is now an okay time?
Great. We work with companies on press coverage, and I'm calling to ask whether you have any news coming up that might be worth pitching to journalists?
Hmm. What kind of news are we talking?
Anything that might be interesting to the media - new products, services, partnerships, milestones, that sort of thing. Do you have anything like that in the pipeline?
No problem. Well, if that changes and you do have something coming up, feel free to get in touch. Thanks for your time, and goodbye.
